g.text: Karnaugh-map groups contain powers of two in Gray-code adjacency

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: Four independent four-variable maps, not overlapping groups of one function. Row and column order00,01,11,10 changes one bit at a time; opposite edges are

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: adjacent. Each shown group contains only ones. In SOP minimization, a variable that changes within a group is eliminated.
